title: Convex-SKM-Net: Low-Latency Block Halfspace Corrections for Neural Convex Constraint Satisfaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.38197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fast inference and strict constraint satisfaction are essential for learning-based decision-making. Existing methods often rely on constraint-specific projections or feasible-set parameterizations, while iterative repair can be costly. We introduce Convex-SKM-Net, a convex constraint-satisfaction layer that forms linearization halfspaces from residual and (sub)gradient oracles without constraint-specific inequality projectors. It applies fixed-depth dual projected-gradient descent (dual PGD) to minimum-displacement block problems using GPU-friendly matrix operations. We jointly learn the predictor and a positive-definite mobility, adapting the correction geometry to improve objective quality. We prove convergence of the outer iterates at fixed dual depth and linear convergence in distance under Slater's condition and bounded subgradients. translated_title: Convex-SKM-Net：用于神经凸约束满足的低延迟块半空间校正
translated_abstract: 快速推理与严格的约束满足对于基于学习的决策至关重要。现有方法通常依赖于针对特定约束的投影或可行集参数化，而迭代修复的代价可能很高。我们提出了Convex-SKM-Net，这是一种凸约束满足层，它从残差和（次）梯度oracle构建线性化半空间，而无需针对特定约束的不等式投影器。该方法利用GPU友好的矩阵运算，对最小位移块问题应用固定深度的对偶投影梯度下降。我们联合学习预测器和一个正定的移动性张量，通过调整校正几何结构来提升目标质量。我们证明了在固定对偶深度下外层迭代的收敛性，以及在Slater条件和有界次梯度条件下距离意义上的线性收敛。在三个二阶锥模型预测控制（SOC-MPC）时域上的所有测试输出……
tldr: 提出Convex-SKM-Net，一种无需约束特定投影器的凸约束满足层，通过固定深度的对偶投影梯度下降和联合学习的正定移动性，实现低延迟且严格满足约束的神经凸约束校正，并给出了收敛性理论保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes Convex-SKM-Net, a convex constraint-satisfaction layer that applies fixed-depth dual projected-gradient descent with a jointly learned positive-definite mobility to achieve low-latency, strictly constraint-satisfying corrections without constraint-specific projectors, with proven convergence guarantees.
